about: Exceptions to the platform boundary (CLAUDE.md), recorded 2026-10-28 when the rule was introduced. Counts are platform statements/commands and platform-name branches outside src/engine/platform/, src/engine/runner/ and src/engine/transforms/. Never raise a count to pass the test; lower counts as code moves. v0.54.1 moved the last TO MOVE entries (probe, reconciliation and EXPLAIN dialects) into the platform definitions (platforms/*.yaml, read by src/engine/platform/dialects.ts); what remains is interface selection and wording.

src/cli/main.ts.why: Interface: which connection, adapter or prerequisite to use for the platform the user named (selection, not platform behaviour).

src/core/agentHub.ts.why: Interface: chooses the platform adapter for the panel's legacy connection (selection, not platform behaviour).

src/core/platformOnboarding.ts.why: Interface: the settings cards' onboarding text and checks per platform (install and sign-in guidance shown to a person).

src/core/webviewProvider.ts.why: Interface: the panel's connection cards and settings per platform (selection, not platform behaviour).

src/engine/context/fileIngestion.ts.why: Estate read: recognises dictionary exports (Oracle ALL_TAB_COLUMNS, Teradata, INFORMATION_SCHEMA) in files the user ingests.

src/extension.ts.why: Interface: commands that pick a connection or adapter by platform (selection, not platform behaviour).

src/mcp/decisions.ts.why: Wording: the runbook tool's description names a Snowflake or Databricks CLI command as an example step for the agent (text, not behaviour). Its dialect mapping moved to the platform definitions in v0.54.1.

src/mcp/platform.ts.why: Interface: the MCP platform tools pick the adapter and connection by platform (selection, not platform behaviour).

src/mcp/workspaceTools.ts.why: Wording: the source-files tool's description says load scripts include COPY INTO (text, not behaviour). Its dialect mapping moved to the platform definitions in v0.54.1.
